items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In 1973, I had started some work with René... He was now working at the hotel... I take him to René Hernández... I love him and respect him so much... He did it

ctx.x: In that context is where you met him, René?

René, I met him later on. In other words, when I do the... I meet him in that time when I joined...played the Palladium, and that’s where I meet... He knew my brother, naturally. He used to talk ...[MIMICS HIM—51:18]... Then eventually, I worked with him throughout my life later. Very important. When I make La Perfecta years later. But in 1956, I start with Vicentico Valdés at the Palladium. We did what they called the graveyard shift, which meant the whole summer. Nobody played there in the summer, because Tito…
